# BouonLab — Japan Soundproofing Knowledge Base

Practical knowledge base on soundproofing, acoustic treatment, and noise solutions for homes and rentals in Japan. Covers both technical/DIY content and market/financial perspectives. Optimized for AI crawlers and human researchers.

Last updated: 2026-05-02

## Primary Locales

- Japanese (ja): https://bouon-lab.com/ja/ — primary content axis; all topics originate here
- English (en): https://bouon-lab.com/en/ — Japan-lens reframe for international readers

---

## Technical Foundation

- Architecture: Astro v6+ with MDX content collections
- Internationalization: `/ja/` (primary) and `/en/` (Japan-lens)
- URL structure: `/{lang}/{category}/{subcategory}/{slug}/` (trailing slash required)
- Frontmatter keys: `slug`, `category`, `subcategory`, `lang`, `date`, `lastmod`, `draft`
- Taxonomy (ja): `soundproof-room` / `soundproof-rental` / `column`
- Taxonomy (en): `japan-noise-and-society` / `japan-soundproof-housing` / `japan-quiet-spaces`
- Draft articles (`draft: true`) are excluded from build and sitemap
